# WorksBuddy
> AI Agent Suite that automates leads, tasks, email, contracts, billing, workflows, and content. Seven specialized AI agents that connect and share data automatically.
WorksBuddy replaces a fragmented stack of single purpose SaaS tools with one connected system. Seven AI agents run core business functions and share one data layer, so a won deal can trigger an onboarding project, an invoice, and a follow up campaign with zero manual handoffs.
## Platform
- [WorksBuddy Home](https://worksbuddy.ai/index.md): AI Agent Suite overview: seven connected AI agents that automate core business functions on one platform.
- [How It Works](https://worksbuddy.ai/how-it-works.md): One login, all agents, zero switching. How the seven WorksBuddy agents connect and share one data layer.
- [Pricing](https://worksbuddy.ai/pricing.md): Flat per user pricing: Starter $49, Growth $99, Scale $199, Enterprise custom. Free trial, no credit card.
## Agents
- [Lio: AI Lead Management Agent](https://worksbuddy.ai/lio.md): Captures, enriches, scores, and routes leads in real time; enriches contacts from a LinkedIn URL and predicts who is ready to sign.
- [Lio Features](https://worksbuddy.ai/lio/features.md): Full Lio feature breakdown and capabilities.
- [Taro: AI Task and Project Management Agent](https://worksbuddy.ai/taro.md): Creates tasks from natural language, auto prioritizes work, distributes workload, and predicts project risk across sprints, kanban, and epics.
- [Taro Features](https://worksbuddy.ai/taro/features.md): Full Taro feature breakdown and capabilities.
- [Evox: AI Email Marketing Agent](https://worksbuddy.ai/evox.md): Builds and sends email campaigns and behavior triggered sequences with A/B testing, personalization, send time optimization, and pre send spam checks.
- [Evox Features](https://worksbuddy.ai/evox/features.md): Full Evox feature breakdown and capabilities.
- [Sigi: AI E-Signature and Contracts Agent](https://worksbuddy.ai/sigi.md): Sends documents for legally valid digital signature with clause intelligence, contract risk analysis, and missing clause detection.
- [Sigi Features](https://worksbuddy.ai/sigi/features.md): Full Sigi feature breakdown and capabilities.
- [Inzo: AI Billing and Finance Agent](https://worksbuddy.ai/inzo.md): Automates invoicing, payment reminders, late fees, expenses, and collections, with cash flow forecasting and payment reliability scoring.
- [Inzo Features](https://worksbuddy.ai/inzo/features.md): Full Inzo feature breakdown and capabilities.
- [Revo: AI Workflow Automation Agent](https://worksbuddy.ai/revo.md): Connects every WorksBuddy agent and 3,000+ external tools through no code, drag and drop workflows and cross agent triggers.
- [Revo Features](https://worksbuddy.ai/revo/features.md): Full Revo feature breakdown and capabilities.
- [Ranko: AI SEO and GEO Content Agent](https://worksbuddy.ai/ranko.md): Plans topics, writes articles, and tracks how often your brand is mentioned by AI engines, with site inspection and one click fix tickets.
- [Ranko Features](https://worksbuddy.ai/ranko/features.md): Full Ranko feature breakdown and capabilities.
## Solutions
- [Sales & Revenue](https://worksbuddy.ai/solutions/sales-revenue.md): Lio + Evox + Inzo close the loop, from first touch to paid invoice.
- [Operations & PM](https://worksbuddy.ai/solutions/operations-pm.md): Taro + Revo run the work, from tasks and sprints to automated workflows.
- [Finance & Legal](https://worksbuddy.ai/solutions/finance-legal.md): Inzo + Sigi for billing, invoicing, contracts, and e-signature.
- [Marketing](https://worksbuddy.ai/solutions/marketing.md): Ranko + Evox for content, SEO, and email campaigns.
- [HR & People](https://worksbuddy.ai/solutions/hr-people.md): Onboarding, documents, and team coordination across agents.
## Use Cases
- [Lead to Cash Automation](https://worksbuddy.ai/use-cases/lead-to-cash.md): From first touch to paid invoice with zero manual handoffs.
- [Contract Lifecycle](https://worksbuddy.ai/use-cases/contract-lifecycle.md): Draft, sign, and track contracts in one connected flow.
- [Replace Your Tool Stack](https://worksbuddy.ai/use-cases/replace-stack.md): Swap 4–5 single-purpose tools for one connected platform.
- [Cash-Flow Visibility](https://worksbuddy.ai/use-cases/cash-flow-visibility.md): Forecast cash flow 30/60/90 days out from live billing data.
- [AI-Native PM](https://worksbuddy.ai/use-cases/ai-native-pm.md): The project management tool that does the PM-ing for you.
## Industries
- [WorksBuddy for Healthcare](https://worksbuddy.ai/industry/healthcare.md): Streamline patient acquisition, appointment follow ups, team coordination, billing, and outreach with AI agents for healthcare built for clinics, medspas, telehealth providers, and healthcare practices
- [WorksBuddy for Real Estate](https://worksbuddy.ai/industry/real-estate.md): 48% of leads go cold in an hour. WorksBuddy's AI tools for real estate agents respond instantly, qualify prospects, book visits, and close deals for
- [WorksBuddy for IT Services](https://worksbuddy.ai/industry/it-service.md): 52% of IT leads go cold before reps open CRM. WorksBuddy fixes this: AI agents respond in 30 seconds, qualify prospects, schedule demos, and send
- [WorksBuddy for Logistics](https://worksbuddy.ai/industry/logistics.md): Every dispatch call, customer check in, and invoice dispute costs your team time
- [WorksBuddy for Automobile](https://worksbuddy.ai/industry/automobile.md): Never lose a lead again. WorksBuddy captures every inquiry, follows up instantly
- [WorksBuddy for Education](https://worksbuddy.ai/industry/education.md): Students choose who replies first. WorksBuddy makes sure that's always you
- [WorksBuddy for Finance](https://worksbuddy.ai/industry/finance.md): AI agents for finance firms that handle client acquisition, follow ups, compliance, invoicing, and outreach. Built for accounting firms, advisors, and consultancies ready to stop
- [WorksBuddy for Food and Beverage](https://worksbuddy.ai/industry/food-beverages.md): WorksBuddy is purpose built for AI in food and beverage industry operations, automating order management, follow ups, production, invoicing, and outreach for manufacturers, cloud kitchens
- [WorksBuddy for SaaS](https://worksbuddy.ai/industry/saas.md): The shift to AI in SaaS is changing how teams retain users and grow revenue. WorksBuddy automates onboarding, re-engagement, and renewals so your team focuses

brings everything together in one AI-powered workspace.

===== product :: https://worksbuddy.ai/lio/features.md

# Lio Features
## which leads to call.
Lio is your AI powered lead management CRM. It works as lead capture software that enriches leads from LinkedIn in seconds, scores and ranks them against your ICP, predicts who's ready to sign, and manages your entire pipeline so your team focuses on closing, not admin
- **10+** AI analysis features
- **15+** Core CRM modules
- **500 to 1k** LinkedIn URLs per batch
- **Real time** SSE + Ably live sync
## AI Intelligence
LIO distributes leads the instant they're qualified no manual assignment, no wait times. Every rep gets the right volume matched to their live capacity.
### AI Lead Scoring
LIO scores every lead from zero to one hundred and tells you why, so you spend your day on the ones most likely to buy.
/lio/features/ai-lead-scoring
### AI Email Personalization
LIO drafts a personal email for each lead using real details about them, so you sound relevant from the very first line.
### Intent Alerts & Buying Signals
LIO watches for the little moves that mean a lead is warming up and alerts you right away, so you reach out while they are paying attention.
### Conversation Intelligence
LIO records, transcribes, and summarizes every call and meeting, then turns the key points into follow-ups, so you can focus on the conversation.
### Deal Forecasting
LIO scores every open deal on how likely it is to close and flags the ones at risk, so you know your forecast and where to step in.
### Ask LIO
Ask a plain question about any lead or deal and LIO answers from your own calls, emails, and notes, with a link to the exact source.
### Dashboards & AI Analytics
Drag the cards you care about onto one board, pick a chart or a table, and watch it update in real time as your team works.
## Lead Management
A complete command center for every lead in your pipeline from lead capture to closed deal. The lead tracking software your team needs with every field, filter, and bulk action, without the bloat
### Lead Management
See, sort, and act on every lead from one screen, so nothing slips away and your team knows the next move.
/lio/features/lead-management
### Lead Workspace
Save your favorite views, arrange your columns, and pin the tabs you use most, so your day opens the way you like it.
### Contacts & Companies
Keep every contact, company, and client linked in one place, so you always see who you are talking to and the whole story behind them.
### Inbox & Email Sync
Connect Gmail or Outlook and read, reply, and send from LIO. Each message links itself to the right lead, so the whole thread lives where you work.
### Meetings Calendar
See your whole calendar, pick a time that is free, and send the lead an invite with the video link, all without leaving LIO.
### Calling & AI Voice Agent
Call leads straight from LIO, get every call recorded and written up for you, and let an AI voice agent take the ones you cannot get to.
### CRM Migration & Sync
Connect HubSpot or Pipedrive, map your fields, and bring your leads, contacts, and companies into LIO clean, de-duplicated, and enriched.
## Pipeline & Deals
Full sales pipeline management built into your CRM. Use LIO as your pipeline management software to build any sales process, track deal value through every stage, and predict which deals will close before your forecast is due.
### Pipeline & Deals
Your deals live on one board that scores what is likely to close and flags the ones slipping, so you always know which one to work next.
/lio/features/pipeline-deals
### Workflow Automation
Build simple if-this-then-that rules that assign, tag, email, and follow up on leads for you, so the routine work happens without you touching it.
### Connected Apps
Link your email, calendar, calling, meetings, and lead sources to LIO in a few clicks, so everything works together in one place.
### Data Import & Export
Import your leads, contacts, and companies from a spreadsheet in a few clicks, and export any list to a clean Excel file whenever you need it.
### User Roles & Permissions
Build roles that fit your team, decide who can see and change what, right down to their own records or everyone's, and keep the whole thing auditable.
### Workspace Administration
Run a guided setup, start from an industry template, and switch on only the modules you need, so LIO fits how your team sells from day one.
### Reports & Custom Analytics
Pick the fields and filters you need, see them as a chart or a table, and export a clean report to PDF, Excel, or CSV in seconds.
## Lio talks to every
other WorksBuddy agent
Single product lead management tools stop at the deal. Lio is wired into the entire WorksBuddy OS so a won deal triggers an onboarding project in Taro, an invoice in Inzo, and a revenue update in Moni. Automatically, with zero manual handoffs.

Add-ons
Two agents priced on their own
EVOX and RANKO don't fit a per-seat model — their value scales with usage, not headcount. So each keeps its own plan you can add anytime.
Why they're separate
EVOX is priced by how many emails you send, and RANKO by how many prompts you track across AI engines. Charging those per seat would punish a small team sending big volume — and overcharge a big team sending little. They plug into the same login and the same shared wallet; you just pick the plan that matches your usage.
EVOX · Email
Cold outreach, warmup, unlimited mailboxes & AI Ghost Writer. Priced by sends.

RANKO · AI search
Track your Share of AI Voice across ChatGPT, Claude & more. Priced by prompts.
$49
/ mo

Questions & Answers
Good to know
What counts as a "seat"?
+
A seat is one person on your team. Every seat unlocks all four apps at their full tier and adds 1,999 credits to your shared wallet. You can add or remove seats anytime, and billing adjusts on your next cycle.
How does the shared credit wallet work?
+
All of your seats' credits pool into one balance. Any teammate can spend them on any app, so a busy month in the CRM and a quiet month in automation simply balance out. Routine work never costs credits — they only apply to delivered AI outcomes like a voice call, a clause review, or a cash-flow forecast.
What happens if I run out of credits?
+
You're never blocked mid-task. Top up anytime from $25, and unused included credits roll over for one month. You upgrade for more headroom, never to unlock a feature.
Why are Evox and Ranko not in the Prime price?
+
Their value scales with usage rather than headcount — by emails sent and by prompts tracked. A per-seat price would be unfair in both directions, so each keeps its own plan. They share the same login and wallet, and you add either whenever you need it.
Is there really no card required to start?
+
Correct. Start a 14-day free trial with no card. If WorksBuddy One isn't right for you, do nothing and it simply ends.
